title: Data-only attacks are easier than you think (2024)
summary: This USENIX article explores how data-only attacks, which focus on stealing information without modifying systems or executing code, are simpler and more prevalent than security professionals typically realize, challenging common assumptions about what constitutes a serious security threat.
problem_solved: Addresses the misconception that attacks requiring code execution are the primary threat, revealing that pure data theft can be achieved through simpler methods.
why_valuable: Raises awareness about an underestimated attack vector that bypasses traditional defenses focused on preventing code execution, helping security teams prioritize data protection.
